BMHRC Group B & C Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 66 Engineer, Officer and More Posts - Complete Details

BMHRC has released the new notification for the recruitment of Group B & C under New Vacancy 2026 for 66 Posts. The online application process will be conducted from 17 September 2026 to 16 October 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, bmhrc.ac.in

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 September 2026 at 10:00 AM
  • Last Date : 16 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM
  • Last date to register, apply and pay the fee : 16 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM
  • Fee reconciliation and settlement date : 17 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM
  • All other candidates : Rs.590 plus applicable transaction or platform charges
  • Examination Mode : Online Computer Based Test
  • Exam Cities : Bhopal, New Delhi and Nagpur

  • Post : Essential Qualification
  • Assistant Accounts Officer : Degree with two years of experience in cash, accounts and budget work in an eligible government, PSU, autonomous or statutory organization.
  • Perfusionist Grade-II : Degree in Perfusion Technology with two years of relevant experience, or Diploma in Perfusion Technology with three years of relevant experience.
  • Assistant Administrative Officer : Degree with two years of experience in administration, accounts or establishment in an eligible government, PSU, autonomous or statutory body.
  • Pharmacist : 12th pass with Science, two-year Diploma in Pharmacy and registration with the State Pharmacy Council.
  • Store In-charge : Degree in Pharmacy, or Diploma in Pharmacy with five years of experience as a Medical Storekeeper.
  • Store Keeper : 12th with Science, Diploma in Pharmacy and two years of experience as Store Keeper in medical stores.
  • Personal Assistant : 12th pass with the prescribed dictation and computer-transcription skills. A relevant certificate must be produced.
  • SC, ST, PwBD, Women and Ex-Servicemen : Exempted
  • SC/ST : 5 years
  • OBC : 3 years
  • PwBD with OBC : 13 years
  • PwBD with SC/ST : 15 years
  • Total Questions : 100 multiple-choice questions

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
